segments.name: Middle-market lending
segments.description: Originates and holds secured debt, unsecured debt and select equity investments in U.S. middle-market companies.
segments.evidence: Segment reporting, the Company has determined that it operates through a single operating and reporting segment with the investment objectives to generate current income and, to a lesser extent, capital appreciation through direct origination of secured debt, unsecured debt and select equity investments.

revenueModel.text: Middle-market portfolio companies pay the Company interest on the debt it holds, plus loan origination and other fees, dividends and capital gains.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenues primarily through receipt of interest income from the investments we hold.
